prompt: Food delivery A/B test: click-to-order rate, baseline 7.8%, MDE +0.8pp, 95% confidence, 80% power, 35k users/week

assertions.description: Sample size per group should be approximately 18,439 users
Total sample size for both groups should be approximately 36,878 users
Estimated test duration should be approximately 8 days with given traffic
Test should be marginally feasible (requires ~1.05x weekly traffic)
Test design achieves 80% statistical power at 95% confidence level
Relative uplift from baseline should be approximately 10.3%
